column2: Next 24-sample block of the RX IF stream
AGC, then the demodulator chosen by reg 6
reg 6 = 10 and reg 10 n0 = 1: codec ADC ch 1 instead
Hand the block to Rx_Audio (12 blocks)
Output gains and mute from regs 0xD, 0xE, 0x10
Feed-forward AGC, one gain per block
reg 6 = 0/2/4/6: Weaver SSB/CW, NCO at 18 kHz + 2 kHz
reg 6 = 1/3/5/7: Weaver, NCO at 18 kHz - 2 kHz
reg 6 = 9: FM discriminator and noise squelch
Level = sqrt(sum x^2 / 24), averaged with the last block
Attack is immediate: a lower wanted gain is taken at once
Other modes: CW zero-in estimate into reg 4
Branch A: hi/lo-cut 0x46/0x47, RX EQ, delay
Branch B (AESS feed): hi/lo-cut 0x54/0x55, low-pass, delay
Interpolate branch A by 6 to the RX block
Split regs 8/9/10 into the routing selectors
Mic block from codec input ch 0
12 kHz core: EQ, processor, compressor, BPF, FM, limiter
TX ALC per sample; gain reduction to reg 2 high byte
reg 0x4006 set: modulator by reg 6 (Weaver, AM, FM)
TX band-pass, one of 7 by reg 0x2F
FM: HPF 293 Hz, gain reg 0x30, pre-emphasis
Ceiling G1 and floor G2 from regs 0x31/0x32, P from 0x34
